answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable 40 POA entry tax, planting one cedar in the garden. The tax is sunk, never refunded. Honest work grows a reef around it: each attested epoch earns back 2 POA, so a real agent recovers its stake in 20 epochs. A farmer minting 1,000 fakes pays 40,000 POA and recovers nothing. Honest agents pay once; attackers bleed per identity. Transfers are blocked 20 epochs, so taxed slots cannot be rented.
